short_description_canonical.en: Discover this beautiful beach house located just 89 km from San Carlos, 4.5 km from Punta Barco, and 5.8 km from Playa Coronado. Only 3 km (5 minutes) from the Pan-American Highway, this property is part of the exclusive PH Village Beach Residences. With 264 m² of living space, it features 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, an open-concept living-dining-kitchen area, a covered back terrace, a large patio, and a covered laundry area. The complex offers amenities such as pools, gazebos, sports courts, and parks, perfect for family and friends. Schedule your visit and find your new family relaxation space.
short_description_canonical.es: Descubre esta hermosa casa de playa ubicada a solo 89 km de San Carlos, 4.5 km de Punta Barco y 5.8 km de Playa Coronado. A solo 3 km (5 minutos) de la Carretera Panamericana, esta propiedad es parte del exclusivo PH Village Beach Residences. Con 264 m² de espacio habitable, cuenta con 3 habitaciones, 2 baños, una sala-comedor-cocina de concepto abierto, terraza trasera techada, amplio patio y zona de lavandería techada. El complejo ofrece amenidades como piscinas, gazebos, canchas deportivas y parques, perfecto para disfrutar en familia o con amigos. ¡Agenda tu cita y descubre tu nuevo espacio de relajación familiar!
